req.title: Player payload includes position
req.statement: The system shall include the position field on every player response.

doc.reasoning: The requirement specifies that the player payload must include the 'position' field in every response. This is a critical field for identifying the player's role in the team. The test suite will verify that the 'position' field is present and correctly handled in various scenarios, including valid, invalid, and boundary cases.

tests.name: test_get_player_by_id_includes_position
preconditions: Player with ID '97da2849-d73e-4b43-8a90-7d090402c802' exists in the database.
expected: Response JSON includes 'position' field with value 'Defensive Midfield'.
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)
response = client.get('/players/97da2849-d73e-4b43-8a90-7d090402c802')
assert response.status_code == 200
assert response.json()['position'] == 'Defensive Midfield'

tests.name: test_get_player_by_id_not_found
preconditions: Player with ID '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000' does not exist in the database.
tests.executable:
from main import app
from fastapi.testclient import TestClient
client = TestClient(app)
response = client.get('/players/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000')

tests.name: test_get_player_by_id_boundary_case
